{{*}} [[Tiptoe]] |map = {{Map|name=Draynor manor|zoom=1|mtype=polygon|3114,3331|3108,3331|3106,3329|3103,3329|3102,3330|3099,3330|3097,3332|3093,3332|3092,3331|3086,3331|3083,3333|3083,3337|3084,3338|3084,3340|3083,3341|3083,3347|3086,3349|3086,3353|3084,3354|3084,3359|3084,3364|3085,3365|3085,3370|3083,3372|3083,3377|3085,3379|3085,3384|3088,3387|3091,3387|3092,3388|3098,3388|3099,3387|3102,3387|3103,3386|3107,3386|3108,3385|3118,3385|3127,3376|3127,3375|3128,3374|3128,3371|3127,3370|3127,3367|3130,3364|3130,3355|3129,3354|3129,3347|3128,3346|3128,3340|3127,3339|3127,3334|3124,3331|3120,3331|3119,3330|3115,3330|3114,3331}}|type = building |leagueRegion = Misthalin }} {{Relative location |location = Draynor Manor |north = Barbarian Village |east = Champions' Guild |south = Draynor Village |west = Falador }} '''Draynor Manor''' is a large, haunted, mansion located north of [[Draynor Village]] owned by [[Count Draynor|Count Draynor Drakan]]. The manor contains 4 floors and is a central location for 3 [[quests]]: [[Ernest the Chicken]], [[Vampyre Slayer]], and [[Animal Magnetism]], and is visited briefly during [[Fairytale I - Growing Pains]]. It also holds a portal that grants access to the [[Killerwatt plane|dimension]] where [[killerwatt]]s reside. There is a [[Belladonna patch]] outside the manor, towards the west and within the fence. Upon entering the manor through the front doors, the doors will lock behind the player. There is an exit in the eastern-most room that can be used to leave the building. The yard around the mansion contains [[Dead tree|dead trees]] that can be chopped down, but also [[Undead tree|undead trees]] that can attack the player and deal 0 to 3 damage. In the south-eastern part of the yard, [[Vine (Draynor Manor)|vines]] can spawn from the ground that deal 1 damage to the player. == Transportation == A few teleports bring the player close to the manor: * {{Plink|Draynor Manor Teleport}} — directly to the manor doors via the {{Plink|Arceuus spellbook}}. Players can also use the [[Draynor manor teleport_(tablet)|magic tablet equivalent]]. * {{Plink|Amulet of glory|pic=Amulet of glory(4)}} — to [[Draynor Village]] then walk north to the manor * {{Plink|Chronicle}} — to the [[Champions' Guild]] then run west to the manor via the stepping stones (31 [[Agility]]). == Basement == Draynor Manor has a basement which is visited in the [[Ernest the Chicken]] quest. This basement consists of different rooms containing levers connected by doors. Each door opens only when the levers are in certain positions. The lever positions required to open each door are specified in the table below. In this table, "D" means the lever needs to be down, "U" means the lever needs to be up, "x" means the lever doesn't affect the door, and "?" means it isn't certain whether the door is affected by the lever. [[File:Ernest the Chicken - Oil can map.png|alt=A map of the basement fo Draynor manor. It has several rooms seperated by doors, marked 1 through 9, and several levers, marked A through F. Levers A and B are in the entrance room, which connects to the room with levers C and D through door 1 in the north. This room is connected to to small adjecent rooms to the west by doors 2 (in the south-west) and 7 (in the north-west). These small rooms are in turn connected together by door 8, and the southern one is connected to the entrance room by door 3. These two small rooms are connected by two more small rooms to their west by doors 6 (in the north-west) and 4(in the south-west). These small rooms are in turn connected by door 5. The northern of these two rooms contains levers E and F. Finally, the entrance room connects to a room in the west through door 9. This final room contains the oil canister needed for the Ernest the Chicken quest.|thumb|A map of the Draynor manor basement, marking each door and lever used in the puzzle.]] {| class="wikitable mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" |+ Required lever positions for each door to be open ! ! colspan="6" |Lever Positions |- !Door !A !B !C !D !E !F |- !1 |D |D |U |x |U? |U |- !2 |D |x |U |x |U |U |- !3 |x |x |x |D |U |x |- !4 |x |x |x |D |U |x |- !5 |x |U |x |D |x |U |- !6 |x |U |x |D |x |D |- !7 |U |U? |x |x |D |D |- !8 |x |x |x |D? |U |D |- !9 |x |x |D |D |x |D |} ==Inhabitants== ''For a full list of NPCs involved in the area, see the [[Draynor Manor#Navboxes|navigation boxes]] at the bottom of the page.'' *{{Chatl|Veronica}}, Ernest's girlfriend who will [[Animal Magnetism|ask the player to find him]]. *{{Chatl|Ernest}}, Veronica's wayward boyfriend. *{{Chatl|Professor Oddenstein}}, the mad scientist who delayed [[Ernest]]. *{{Chatl|Witch|txt=Helda the Witch}}, involved in the [[Animal Magnetism]] quest. *{{Chatl|Ava}}, a scientist from whom the player can acquire [[Ava's attractor|Ava's devices]]. ===Monsters=== *[[Count Draynor]] *[[Ghost]] *[[Rat]] *[[Skeleton (Draynor Manor)|Skeleton]] *[[Spider]] ==Quests== *[[Ernest the Chicken]] *[[Vampyre Slayer]] *[[Animal Magnetism]] *[[Fairytale I - Growing Pains]] *[[Holy Grail]] *[[Dragon Slayer II]] ==Trivia== *If a free-to-play player uses a spade on the grave mount behind the manor, a message will appear, saying "You dig up an unusual item. There doesn't seem to be any use for it around here, so you leave it alone." *The name 'Draynor Manor' is likely a reference to the {{Wp|Drayton Manor Theme Park}} in Staffordshire, a county north-west of Jagex Headquarters. *Occasionally, a figure will briefly appear hung on the [[gallows]] behind the manor before disappearing. This is likely Guy, who is buried to the west of the gallows between the trees, as the gravestone examine says "Here lies Guy, who told a lie, so we swung him from the gallows high." {{Anchor|Navboxes}} {{Vampyre Slayer}} {{Ernest the Chicken}} {{Animal Magnetism}} [[Category:Manors and mansions]]
